desc: Ideate approaches and identify binary-search + DP feasibility as baseline.
Implement `Solution.minLength` with binary search over L and a helper `can(L)` using O(L) DP arrays for last bit and current run length.

In `can(L)`, initialize states for the first character, transition by extending the same bit when run length < L or switching to the opposite bit to reset run length to 1, adding flip cost when chosen bit differs from `s[i]`.
Cap DP values at `numOps + 1`, return feasible if any final state cost <= `numOps`, and binary search for the smallest feasible L.
Test the provided examples and edge cases: `numOps = 0`, `n = 1`, all identical characters, and enough operations to force an alternating string; include a small brute-force cross-check.
